decision.summary: A sharp, multi-sample downward step in U begins near index 630, sustained through at least index 642, with no observed opposing return within allowed context [590,670]. E shows a weak correlated upward change, N only a transient spike—no clean platform or reversal confirms a temporary offset; status remains uncertain due to unobserved recovery.
